title: fix(platform-objects): API key Revoke and Restore toasts name the key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：API 密钥列表的「吊销」「恢复」两个行操作，成功提示从「API key revoked / restored」改为写出密钥名（如 `API key "QA key" revoked`），中文、日文、西班牙文译文同步写出密钥名。
- 为什么改：违反写入反馈约定（#25849 裁决 C：记录级成功提示要点名记录），QA 在 18.3.0 RC 轮发现。
- 风险与回滚：只改两条提示文案的元数据，控制台早已按行把 `{{ record.name }}` 填进提示；回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据或协议变化。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts`（两行 successMessage）、`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key-action-copy.test.ts`、`zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` 的两条译文。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/identity/sys-api-key-action-copy.test.ts`，预期 15 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27456

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `sys_api_key`'s `revoke_api_key` and `restore_api_key` row actions declare `successMessage: 'API key "{{ record.name }}" revoked'` / `'... restored'`. Both are `list_item` actions; the console's `ActionRunner` fills a `successMessage` `{{ record.* }}` hole from the row the dispatch carries (`composeSuccessMessage` reads `dispatchRecord(action)`), already pinned in objectui's `ActionRunner.copyTemplate-13367.test.ts`, test "the row a dispatch carries is `record`". `record` is one of `ACTION_SUCCESS_TEMPLATE_ROOTS`, so the action-copy publish judge accepts the hole. `name` is a required field on `sys_api_key`, so the hole always has a value.
- The translated bundles (zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES) carry the same hole, hand-written. Merge mode keeps a translated value forever, so without this a zh-CN viewer would keep the key-less sentence while `check:i18n` reads "in sync".
- `en.objects.generated.ts` regenerated from the source with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` (exit 0; only those two leaves moved).
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

## Tests

- New `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key-action-copy.test.ts` (the shape of `invite-user-action-copy.test.ts`): the source copy carries `{{ record.name }}`; the en bundle equals the source; each translated bundle carries the token and is not the English source; the served object metadata (`translateMetadataDocument` over `SetupAppTranslations`) gives zh-CN its translated key-naming copy and en the declared copy.
- Ablation (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored and hash-verified): the revoke line back to `'API key revoked'` turns 3 of 15 cases red (declared copy, en bundle, en served); restored, 15/15 green.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 98 files / 1384 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The acceptance's rendering layer is the console runner, which this PR does not change; its interpolation of a row's `record` into `successMessage` is the existing objectui test named above, so the pin here is the metadata plus that test.
- The surface was widened, with the seat's approval, from the two source lines to the same two values in the four `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles.

## Verification

On head `6a8ef24c3c`: the derived list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 59 families) plus `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, each exit code recorded before any pipe; `--ran` reconciliation exit 0: 58 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, needs a whole-workspace build; left to CI). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone, and 0 after `git fetch --unshallow`. The full readings are in the report comment on #27456.
